verdict.rationale: Linear's 'Loops' feature explicitly lets users describe a job in plain language and choose to run it on a schedule or in response to an event, directly matching the story of recurring/scheduled automation for routine team work (docs-11, docs-36). Additional docs show loops handling recurring tasks like keeping docs updated and being shareable/favoritable as team workflows (docs-12, docs-34, docs-77, docs-23). missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of Loops in production use, and detail on reliability/error-handling for scheduled runs.
